spec.situation_desc: transferred money to someone pretending to be from the bank

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’m Yasmin Delacroix. I transferred money to someone who pretended to be from your fraud team, and I’m really unhappy with how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has happened, Yasmin. Before I discuss anything about your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s matched. I’m sorry you’ve been left feeling unhappy about this.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: They called saying there was suspicious activity and told me to move £2,450 to a safe account. I did it, and then I realised it was a scam.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I can see why you’d be upset about that.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I contacted the bank afterwards, but I don’t feel like anyone took it seriously.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve had that experience. I’m logging this as a complaint about the way the matter has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The complaint will be reviewed, and someone will be in touch about it. I can’t say what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right, there’s no decision I can give you today. The complaint process will look at what you’ve raised.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I just want the bank to understand how serious this is.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I do understand, Yasmin, and I’m sorry this has been so frustrating.
